description: Unexecuted template (PR-VID-MOTION-420). Bind your own images and driving videos, then replace each case's alignment numbers with the alignment you accepted in Align Motion for that exact source image and driver (an alignment never transfers to another subject). Both arms share the seed, workflow, version, length, controls, original driver and temporal frame selection; only the spatial alignment differs. A physical run needs the owner's separate authorization. Diagnostic sample: one subject across the four alignment scenarios (8 jobs, includes the pilot cells).

cases.prompt: a woman with long brown hair in a dark jacket, standing in a plain studio, full figure, photorealistic

motion.action: Raises the right hand to shoulder height and waves twice, then lowers it.
motion.motion_prompt: the person raises their right hand, waves twice and lowers it, body otherwise still
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject waves with their right hand twice and lowers it; the body, face and background stay still and nothing is duplicated.

cases.prompt: a woman with long brown hair in a dark jacket, standing in a plain studio, full figure, photorealistic

motion.action: Raises both arms overhead and lowers them.
motion.motion_prompt: the person raises both arms overhead, holds for a moment and lowers them, feet planted
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject raises both arms overhead and lowers them with the feet planted; the arms stay inside the frame and the body is not duplicated.

compatibility: driver subject larger than source subject

cases.prompt: a woman with long brown hair in a dark jacket, standing in a plain studio, full figure, photorealistic

motion.action: Walks toward the camera with a steady stride.
motion.motion_prompt: the person walks steadily toward the camera, arms swinging naturally, camera locked
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject walks toward the camera with a plausible stride and keeps their identity; the trajectory stays inside the frame and the background is steady.

alignment.note: initial-state alignment of the whole figure

compatibility: source has space around the figure

cases.prompt: a woman with long brown hair in a dark jacket, standing in a plain studio, full figure, photorealistic

motion.action: Starts facing the camera and turns the head to the subject's left into profile.
motion.motion_prompt: the person starts facing the camera, slowly turns their head to their left into profile and holds, shoulders still
motion.expected_outcome: The intended subject turns the head smoothly into profile and holds; spatial alignment alone is not expected to change a start-pose difference, which is what this case measures.

alignment.note: framing only; a pose difference is not a geometric one

annotations.start_pose: facing the camera (source starts slightly turned)
